target_customer: Remote software and product teams paying per seat for project management
problem: Specs, tasks, roadmaps and user feedback live in disconnected tools and Jira is slow.
product_category: Product development and project management software

founders.name: Sigurd Seteklev
founders.background_notes: Product management experience from team to director level.

founders.name: Kevin Simons
founders.background_notes: Managed software development teams for about 10 years per YC profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time collaborative editing plus integrations (Intercom, Zapier) is standard but non trivial SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Project data creates some lock in, but issue trackers were crowded and copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Jira remained dominant; ClickUp acquired Kitemaker and the service closed 2025-09-01.

market_need_then: Teams complained of tool fragmentation per the founders' launch post; no spend data found.

identity.logo: Kite themed imagery on Product Hunt, no description found

brand_strength.rationale: No outside coverage of the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Kitemaker was a Oslo based Jira alternative combining specs, tasks and feedback. The company site states ClickUp acquired it and the service was discontinued on 1 September 2025, so the product ended rather than continuing as a brand. Funding is unverified aggregator data and no traction numbers were found, so the cause of the soft exit is not public.
notes: ClickUp acquisition rests on Kitemaker's own site banner; no independent press found. Seedtable shows about 2.17M across a 2019 pre-seed and 2021 round (aggregator only, conflicting 130K elsewhere), unverified. Searches for dated competitors returned only 2026 alternative lists, so the list is empty. Acquisition year inferred from the 2025 shutdown date. Completeness pass: the 2019 168K pre-seed and a 2021 2M round rest on Seedtable alone; the 2021-03 EQT Ventures entry (EQT's own portfolio page, no amount) may be the same round as the 2021 one. Welcome to the Jungle says EQT and SNO Ventures led, about 0.2M in 2021-03 and about 2M in 2021-05, total 2.3M; another Seedtable page shows 130K. Overlaps not reconciled.
